title: The Furnace Gate
text: A gate of black iron set in a wall of roaring fire. The latch glows red. It opens only for someone who will hold the latch while the others pass through, and the iron has the shape of many hands burned into it.

options.label: The toughest holds the burning latch.

outcomes.text: Burned to the elbow, and the party through, and their hand-print added to the others.

options.label: Each Scion takes a turn at the latch.

outcomes.text: Everyone burned a little, and everyone through.
Another way, through the devils' kennels, and the devils' dogs.
